QuestInfo.name: One Wish
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #b#p9390355##k, the beggar. He's sitting in a corner in #bEl Nath#k.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9390355##k wants you to get #b10 #t4000021##k items from #bJr. Yetis#k.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: #b#p9390355##k is very thankful. Maybe you should find out more about him.\r\n

yes.0: Thanks, kid. I can make all kinds of stuff with this leather. Like gloves, or a new strap for my banjo... Just wish I had a way to get a fire going.

item.0: Hey, I told you I was hungry.\r\n
